recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If a future issue concerns missing artifacts in the current SDC IG registry, handle that through the SDC IG repository/process rather than this core source checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-8703 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request saying that the SDC registry was missing conformance elements. The Jira resolution was auto-approved, and the only Jira comment said it was already fixed.
initial_application: No commit message found in the current history explicitly mentions FHIR-8703. The likely application is commit 636745d63613e830b5485f77bed313174faaf092 from 2015-09-17, one day after the Jira was filed, which changed guides/sdc/registry.html and added/updated SDC conformance resources.
additional_context: The affected registry was part of temporary SDC implementation-guide content in core. The old guides/sdc tree and guides/sdc/registry.html were deleted from core by commit 9840423d9e1a74dd5011ec394e316afeb02c067d in 2016; current source/igs.xml keeps the SDC and SDC-DE IG entries commented out, source/fhir.ini does not list SupportingDocumentation as an active resource, and current Questionnaire notes point to the external SDC IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is appropriate because the current core build no longer contains the retired DSTU1 SDC registry and current SDC-specific guidance belongs in the external SDC IG.

evidence_items.learned: This is the likely historical application of the missing SDC registry content shortly after the Jira was filed.
